title: Pupil Examination
description: This episode of Focus Cast by focuslinks turns off the lights. The Host and the Guide examine the pupils: what size, shape, and symmetry say, how the light reflex works, and why the swinging flashlight test is such a powerful little maneuver. There is a story about a cyclist and a quiet finding, listener questions about dim rooms and twin pupils, and a myth about the iris. Two small circles, one enormous amount of information.
